== Description ==

At the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025: [[Mike French]] (standing left, grey hoodie) and [[Benji Chu]] (standing, green Team Albany shirt) beside a table with [[Erik Spijksma]] (back left, black shirt), [[Jonny Chu]] (back right, black zip hoodie and glasses), and a bald player in a black Runt eagle hoodie (front, unlabeled).
